title: Who can apply (ukri.org)
text:
This is not a research grant opportunity.
This opportunity is open to organisations with standard or non-standard eligibility Check if your organisation is eligible and who meet the eligibility of this opportunity detailed below.
If you meet the criteria for this funding opportunity detailed by Research England, but are not currently registered to be eligible for UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) funding and would like to be considered for this opportunity. You can apply for UKRI eligibility by completing the due diligence form listed in the link above, alongside applying for this funding opportunity.
Research England will discount any application which does not meet the eligibility criteria of this funding opportunity. If you are unsure, please contact the UKRI Funding Service Helpdesk.
Who is eligible to apply
We welcome applications from groups who can identify and enable joint working across multiple English higher education providers such as:
existing groups with a coordinating function for example, sector alliances, associations and non-profit organisations that convene English higher education providers
new coordinating groups convened for this funding opportunity. For example, groups of professional services staff or institutional leaders who want to work together to explore delivery of joint functions on behalf of their institutions
all coordinating groups must represent multiple English higher education providers and be able to respond to the scope and scale of ambition in this funding opportunity
coordinating groups are welcome to also represent non-English higher education providers. Diverse perspectives are welcome as long as it is contributing to the ambitions of this funding opportunity. For example, if groups include voices with relevant contributions to barriers, challenges and solutions for institutional collaboration for a sustainable cost-effective future such as wider beneficiaries of such collaborations
Who is not eligible to apply
The following are not able to apply:
collaborative research projects
groups that do not represent more than one higher education provider
groups without a clear, coherent and articulated reason for being coordinated to respond to the scope of this opportunity
Equality, diversity and inclusion
We are committed to achieving equality of opportunity for all funding applicants.
Research England funds organisation-led not applicant-led opportunities. As such, we expect organisations in receipt of funding to support people to work in a way that suits their personal circumstances. This includes:
career breaks
support for people with caring responsibilities
flexible working
alternative working patterns
UKRI can offer disability and accessibility support for UKRI applicants and grant holders during the application and assessment process.
